title: The tourist's dog
logline: A tourist's dog on the seawall, young, four legs, straining at a leash toward the old three-legged one under the bench, who does not get up. Two dogs. The page draws the not getting up.

panels.composition: A young dog on a leash held by a tourist straining toward a seawall bench under which an old three-legged dog lies without getting up, July.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a young dog on a leash held by a tourist straining toward a seawall bench beneath which an old three-legged dog lies without getting up, July light, no words
